user.title: Set up NeuralBridge
user.description:
NeuralBridge provides priority-based AI agent routing for Home Assistant's Assist pipeline.

After setup, you can add AI agents with different priorities through the integration options.

**Priority System:**
- Priority 0: Router/Filter agents (e.g. TinyLlama, Qwen for classification)
- Priority 1–100: Processing agents (lower numbers are tried first)

Click Submit to continue.

advanced_settings.title: Advanced Settings
advanced_settings.description: Configure the global response cache. Cached responses are returned instantly, bypassing all agents.

data_description.response_cache_enabled: Cache agent responses to avoid repeated calls for identical inputs.
data_description.response_cache_ttl: How long (in seconds) a cached response remains valid before expiring.
data_description.purge_cache_now: Immediately discard all currently cached responses. Useful after changing agent configurations.

data_description.guard_rail_enabled: Enable hybrid rule-based and AI content filtering on agent responses
data_description.guard_rail_action: What to do when the guard rail flags a response as unsafe
data_description.guard_rail_ai_threshold: Confidence threshold below which AI checking is triggered (0.5 = check often, 1.0 = rules only)

clear_conversation.name: Clear conversation
clear_conversation.description: Clears the session history for a specific conversation ID from NeuralBridge's session memory. Useful when an external caller (e.g. an Alexa Skill) ends a session and wants to free memory immediately.

conversation_id.name: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: The conversation ID to clear (e.g. the Alexa sessionId passed as conversation_id to the HA Conversation API).
